- **FLAG-2 (status-color contradiction):** `NotificationPanel`'s `StatusIcon` maps `cancelled`→grey (`text-status-queued`) while the `Badge` on the same row correctly renders cancelled as amber — an internal contradiction against evidence §B3. Fix is a one-line `StatusIcon` branch change.
- **FLAG-3 / LW-02 (a11y model):** `NotificationPanel`'s dropdown carries `role="menu"` but its children are plain `<button>`s (not `role="menuitem"`) and the list isn't arrow-key navigable — invalid ARIA housing for what is really a notification list, not a menu. - **LW-04 / NOTE-7 (primitive reuse):** the `Badge` status-ramp primitive is reused purely for color on non-status data (admin tier chips, Account Settings "current" chip) — correct output today (explicit `label` passed), but couples tier color to any future status-ramp change. (Informational-only UI-review nits also on file: wordmark weight/size/italic drifts from the mock spec, and font sizes are ad-hoc arbitrary px values with no shared type scale — LOW-8/LOW-9, no action taken.)

## Phase 36 — Home + History + My Workflows [B2]

**Folder:** `.planning/phases/36-home-history-my-workflows-b2/` — 5 plans (36-01..36-05) across 3 waves (Wave 1: 36-01 ∥ 36-02; Wave 2: 36-03 ∥ 36-04, blocked on Wave 1; Wave 3: 36-05, blocked on Wave 2). Branch: `feat/ui-2` @ `6eefa3f1` (working tree clean throughout verification).  ·  **Status:** Complete (2026-07-09) — verifier PASSED, 4/4 ROADMAP success criteria (12/12 supporting truths) VERIFIED; a same-day deep peer review (`36-REVIEW.md`) found 2 High + 2 Medium regressions in the detail-promotion, all fixed and re-verified before close.  ·  **Plan-ids → §36:** 36-01 (rename + fused Home), 36-02 (run-summary endpoint), 36-03 (My Workflows relabel), 36-04 (RunDetailPage + client), 36-05 (History restructure + detail promotion + reskin + post-review fixes).

**Requirements delivered:** **SHELL-02** — fused Home (launcher + deliverable grid + recents strip); History Today/Earlier/Older grouping + tokens/duration sort + real delete wiring; "My Workflows" rename + working kebab actions; `WorkflowCatalog`→`HomeLaunchGrid` rename (D-11); "Catalogue" reserved for a future marketplace. **SHELL-03** — Run detail/reopen page live off a new run-summary endpoint aggregating existing data (agents, KPIs, failure banner, version timeline).

**Driver:** Home, History, and My Workflows were three independently-evolved list surfaces still on the pre-Phase-32 palette, plus a naming collision baked into the product: the data-driven launch grid was called `WorkflowCatalog` while D-11 reserves "Catalogue" for a future shared/org marketplace, and `SavedWorkflowsPage`'s own in-page heading wrongly read "Workflow Catalogue" for the user's own saved workflows. `input` and `home` were two separate navigations for what is really one launch action. History already carried the `created_at`/`token_usage`/`duration` fields needed for date-grouping and sorting but rendered a flat list, and its terminal-run detail was a hand-rolled in-panel JSX block duplicating KPI/agent/timeline/failure surfaces rather than a dedicated page. POR §84/§95 called for these three surfaces to land on the Phase-32 token layer and gain a proper run-detail/reopen page fed by an owner-scoped aggregation endpoint — without regressing the already-shipped KAN-92 (real async titles) and KAN-96 (running-vs-terminal click branch) behaviors.

**One-line outcome:** `WorkflowCatalog` renamed to `HomeLaunchGrid` (D-11, grep 0 across 7 callers) and fused into one Home landing (prompt launcher + deliverable grid + recents strip, no new fetch); History gained Today/Earlier/Older grouping plus a Recent/Tokens/Duration sort layered over the existing family grouping, and its in-panel detail was retired in favor of mounting the new single-source `RunDetailPage`; My Workflows relabeled off "Workflow Catalogue" with its already-wired kebab CRUD now test-locked and its menu hoisted to module scope for correct a11y; a new additive, owner-scoped `GET /api/runs/{id}/summary` aggregates existing `WorkflowRun` columns (zero invented fields, zero new tables) into the KPI/agent/timeline/failure data `RunDetailPage` renders. A same-day peer review then caught and fixed a version-switch column desync (H-01), an empty-quote revision preview (H-02), a formatter dual-implementation (M-02), and lost ISS-024 raw-id-fallback coverage (M-01) — all four verified fixed before the phase closed.

Extracted `_owned_family_members` out of `get_run_family` so `/summary` and `/family` share one owned BFS walk instead of a second copy (INV-12); `get_run_family` refactored to call it with behavior parity (8/8 family tests stayed green). Post-review H-02 fix added an additive `input` field — the owner's own `run.input`, never a child agent's output — so the version-timeline instruction preview has real text.
- **`backend/tests/unit/test_runs_api_summary.py`** — new 8-test suite: owner 200, cross-owner 404, missing 404, malformed/wrong-shape JSON fallback, raw-agent-content-never-echoed, revision-family timeline, foreign-parent walk termination (no leak).

### Key locked decisions (do NOT contradict)

- **(a) D-11 rename is final.** `WorkflowCatalog`→`HomeLaunchGrid` (component + `HomeLaunchGridProps`); "Catalogue" stays reserved for a future shared/org marketplace and must never again label a user's own saved workflows. The component living under `catalog/` is a dev-facing path, not a user-facing label — D-11 governs the latter only.
- **(b) The `input` view is fused-INTO Home, not deleted.** It must stay reachable for the saved-workflow preload path (`handleLaunchSaved` → `pendingHomeBrief`→`initialInput`); deleting it would break the preload flow (INV-3).
- **(c) KAN-96 and KAN-92 are shipped behaviors, preserved verbatim.** KAN-96: a running run click → `onViewRunningPipeline()` (live view); a terminal run click → the detail page. KAN-92: rendered titles come from the real async `run.title`, never a synthesized `Revision:` placeholder.
- **(d) The run-summary endpoint aggregates ONLY existing `WorkflowRun` columns.** Zero invented fields, zero new tables/migrations (Q3); owner-scoped on `WorkflowRun.user_id` (never the nullable `owner_id`); the per-agent projection is a fixed safe-key allow-list — raw output/input_prompt/thinking_text/tool_calls never echoed (V7).
- **(e) Reskin-look, keep-behavior (D-15) — reuse, don't rebuild.** `VersionTimeline`, `DegradedRunAffordance`, `parseFailedAgentIds`/`buildAgentNameById`, and `formatDuration`/`formatTokenCount` are imported, not re-implemented (INV-12); the in-panel hand-rolled detail in `WorkflowHistory` is retired now that `RunDetailPage` is the single source.
- **(f) SC-001/INV-1 — generic-keyed rendering only.** Every branch renders off generic run data (`status`/`agents`/`token_usage`), never a workflow-name/type literal; `MainView` page-keys stay generic (`home`/`input`/`history`/`saved-workflows`), no workflow-name-keyed view was added.

- **SC-001:** `RunDetailPage` + `WorkflowHistory` branch only on status/agents/tokens; `MainView` page-keys stay generic. VERIFIED by the independent verifier (grep + code read).
- **INV-3:** the run-summary endpoint is additive/read-only; the 5 characterization goldens stayed byte-identical — 10/10 pass with `SNAPSHOT_UPDATE` unset, git tree clean after the run.
- **INV-12 (no dual impl):** `_owned_family_members` shared by `/summary` and `/family`; the in-panel KPI/agent/timeline/failure JSX retired from `WorkflowHistory`; `RevisionFamilyView`'s duplicate `formatDuration` deleted post-review (M-02) — single source now `src/lib/runStats.ts`.
- **Owner-scoping / IDOR (V4/V7):** `_owner_gate_or_404` on `WorkflowRun.user_id`; cross-owner and missing runs both resolve to 404 (never 403, never a foreign-data 200); `_SUMMARY_SAFE_AGENT_KEYS` projection proven by a dedicated raw-content-never-echoed test.
- **Token gate:** the retired palette (`#1B2A4A`/`#2563eb`/`#f5f5f0`/Fraunces/JetBrains/Inter-as-font) = 0 across all 8 touched FE files.
- **LOCK-B:** no transport file touched (`useWebSocket`/`useRunStream`/layout untouched); import-linter stayed 4 kept / 0 broken.

## Phase 37 — Configure Unification + Composer/Wizard [B3]

**Folder:** `.planning/phases/37-configure-unification-composer-wizard-b3/` — 6 GSD plans (37-01..37-06, 3 waves: Wave 1 = 37-01 alone [the seam must land first], Wave 2 = 37-02/03/04, Wave 3 = 37-05/06) plus a flagship, unplanned 7th build (37-07 — no PLAN.md, a direct build+SUMMARY born from the first review's WR-01 finding). Branch: `feat/ui-2` (milestone v2.0).  ·  **Status:** Complete (2026-07-10) — verifier PASSED both times it ran: the pre-37-07 pass (HEAD `df679823`) was "passed" but carried 2 open review WARNINGS (WR-01/02 unmounted surfaces, an untracked FIXME); the RE-VERIFY (HEAD `6167b302`, after 37-07 + all review fixes) closed both and scored 3/3 roadmap SC + 23 base plan truths + 8 37-07 unification truths, all VERIFIED, 0 gaps.  ·  **Plan-ids → §37:** 37-01..37-06 [B3] + 37-07 (flagship rebuild, unplanned).

**Requirements delivered:** SHELL-04 — a generic Configure surface (Describe/Templates/Design System/Review Gates/Workflow Settings accordions) for every deliverable type, a 4-tab Agent drawer, and a Workflow dialog, all gated on declared `context_providers`/`user_allowed` signals (ND-1/ND-7/ND-8).

**Driver:** Template and design-system selection were hardwired to the `prototype`/`od_ppt` wizard only — the run-launch boundary decided whether to load them by branching on workflow-name literals, the SC-001/INV-1 leak D-15/C targets. Separately, the composer/wizard mock (evidence 08) that was meant to guide a rebuild was stale — it hardcoded 8 capabilities, modeled retry as a bool, and dropped the validator→gate coupling — so a face-value rebuild would have regressed already-shipped Phase-22 behavior; the phase had to reuse the live surfaces instead of rebuilding from the mock.

**One-line outcome:** A new app-side seam, `launch_context.py::resolve_launch_od_context`, promotes template/design-system context from a `pipeline_type=="od_prototype"/"od_ppt"` name-branch to a declared-signal check (manifest declares `context_providers:[opendesign]` and isn't a legacy `od_`-alias base) called from both the REST and WS launch boundaries — byte-identical for the 3 manifests that already declare it, open by declaration to any future deliverable. Five reused/new FE surfaces (ConfigureScreen, WizardStepper, a DS band-card grid, a 4-tab Agent drawer, WorkflowDialog) reskin onto Phase-32 tokens without dropping any P22 contract (COUPLED_GATE, `RETRY_OPTIONS=[1,2,3]`, live `/api/capabilities`, `user_allowed`). A flagship 7th plan (37-07) then unifies the prototype+ppt route-split pages into one mode-keyed `LaunchWizard` at `/workflow/create`, deleting both legacy pages behind a launch-contract proof byte-identical to the retired flow per mode (25 tests). Two code-review rounds (ISS-046: 0 critical/7 warning/7 info; ISS-047: 0 critical/3 warning/4 info) found unmounted surfaces, a stale model-override save bug, a frozen-chrome toggle bug, and several undertested branches — all closed across 13 follow-up commits.

### What was built

**Backend (4 files: 1 created, 3 modified):**

- `backend/app/api/launch_context.py` (created, Plan 01) — `resolve_launch_od_context(pipeline_type, template_id, design_system_id, *, custom_ds_body, custom_template_body, fatal)`, the shared declared-signal seam. Eligibility = the resolved manifest's `context_providers` includes `"opendesign"` AND `pipeline_type not in _OD_ALIAS_BASE.values()` — the second clause excludes bare `prototype` (whose OD flavor is requested via the dedicated `od_prototype` alias), byte-preserving the legacy split without any name literal. Dispatches to `load_prototype_od_context` or `load_ppt_od_context` by resolved base family, reproducing the old per-branch argument shaping verbatim; a `fatal` flag chooses whether a `LookupError` propagates or is swallowed to `None`.
- `backend/app/api/run_commands.py` — `_resolve_launch_agents` (REST) rewired to call the seam (`fatal=True`); the old name-branch deleted; `od_ppt_revision` kept an explicit `→ None` arm (REST never loaded it pre-phase).
- `backend/app/api/websocket.py` — `_handle_workflow_execution` (WS) rewired to the same seam; `od_ppt_revision` kept its non-fatal arm (`fatal=False`, loads only if `template_id` present).
- `backend/tests/unit/test_rest_run_launch.py` (+170 lines) — new od_context dict-equality parity cases (`od_prototype`/`od_ppt` reproduce the exact pre-seam dict), undeclared-deliverable→`None`, unknown-type rejection, REST `od_ppt_revision`→`None`.

## Phase 38 — Analytics, Estimates & Notifications [B4]

**Folder:** `.planning/phases/38-analytics-estimates-notifications-b4/` (milestone **v2.0**, branch `feat/ui-2`).  ·  **Status:** Complete (2026-07-10) — `38-VERIFICATION.md` verdict **PASS**, 11/11 must-haves verified (SC-1, SC-2 + invariants a–i), 0 FAIL/0 PARTIAL, offline-by-delta, commit range `991f6f1c..2227f241`; a deep code review then found 0 CRITICAL/0 HIGH + 3 MEDIUM/3 LOW/1 NIT, logged same-day as **ISS-048** and triaged in a post-close polish sweep (2 of 3 MEDIUMs fixed, 1 left as-specified — see Known follow-ups).  ·  **Plans:** 5/5 (3 waves: 38-01/02/03 → 38-04 → 38-05)  ·  **Plan-id → `CHAT-AND-UI-CONVERGENCE-PLAN.md` (milestone v2.0 POR):** B4 (brief at line 88; the analytics-endpoint contract clause at line 96).

**Requirements delivered:** **SHELL-05** — "Date-scoped analytics aggregations + chart components + per-deliverable estimates + notifications feed" (`REQUIREMENTS.md:252`, traceability `:474`, this phase's sole REQ-ID) — realizing ROADMAP SC-1 (date-scoped analytics aggregations power the dashboard; filters actually **RECOMPUTE**) and SC-2 (Home deliverable cards show real time/agent estimates; notifications feed live for gate/running/done/failed kinds). Depends on Phase 35 (the shell + `NotificationPanel` chrome); independent of Phases 36/37. This closed the **last offline v2.0 phase** before the Phase-34 live pass (10/11 non-live phases now offline-complete).

**Driver:** Same-session research overturned the evidence docs' "static snapshot" framing: `AnalyticsPage.tsx` was already fully data-driven, but entirely **client-side** — it downloaded up to 500 raw `WorkflowRun` rows via `getWorkflows(limit:500)` and rolled up every KPI/chart/spend figure in the browser, wearing the retired pre-Phase-32 navy palette (100 grep hits). Separately, `useNotifications.ts` exposed `markFailed`/`markCancelled`, and `DashboardLayout.tsx` destructured both — but neither was ever called (only `markCompleted` fired), and no `"gate"` kind existed at all, so failed/cancelled/gated runs produced zero feed entries. Home deliverable cards showed no estimate whatsoever (the mock's hardcoded "~24m · 5 agents" was never wired to anything real).

**One-line outcome:** A new owner-scoped, additive read-only `GET /api/analytics/summary?range=<enum>` aggregation endpoint replaces the client-side 500-row reduce and drives a full Phase-32 reskin of `AnalyticsPage.tsx` behind two newly-extracted, token-styled, a11y-labelled SVG chart primitives (`DonutChart`/`BarChart`, still zero external chart library); `useNotifications` gains a `"gate"` kind + `markGatePaused`/`markGateResumed`, and `DashboardLayout` now actually calls `markFailed`/`markCancelled`/gate transitions off generic `pipelineState` markers; `HomeLaunchGrid` cards render a real `~N agents · ~Xm` estimate from `step_count` plus the endpoint's `type_avg_duration_sec` history, omitting the time clause rather than fabricating it. Zero new tables/migrations, zero engine/transport touch, 5 characterization goldens byte-identical throughout (INV-3/LOCK-B), zero workflow-name branches introduced (SC-001/INV-1).

### What was built

**Backend (3 files: 2 created + 1 modified — plan 38-01):**

- **`backend/app/api/analytics.py`** (NEW) — `GET /api/analytics/summary` router returning an `AnalyticsSummary` Pydantic response (`kpis`/`daily`/`pipelines`/`models`/`spend`/`token_totals`/`type_avg_duration_sec`); owner-scoped on `WorkflowRun.user_id == current_user.id` (never the nullable `owner_id`); `_cutoff_for` range allow-list (`today`/`3d`/`7d`/`30d`/`90d`/`all`, any unknown value defaults to 30d rather than erroring); `_aggregate` pure roll-up keyed on the generic `type`/`status`/`model_id` columns (SC-001/INV-1). `token_usage` is parsed per-run in a try/except → `{}` fallback (DoS guard mirroring `runs.py`); daily buckets accumulate as plain dicts (not attribute access) to stay off the numbers-only `.output` leak-grep; spend is `Σ estimated_cost_usd` read straight from the persisted blob, not re-derived pricing math.
- **`backend/app/main.py`** — registered `analytics_router` beside `runs_router`.
- **`backend/tests/unit/test_analytics_api.py`** (NEW) — owner-isolation (two seeded users, cross-owner totals never leak), recompute-correctness, malformed-`token_usage` (200 not 500), and range-scoping tests (4 tests).

**Frontend (9 files: 2 created + 7 modified — plans 38-02 through 38-05, plus new/extended test files):**

- **`frontend/src/components/analytics/charts/DonutChart.tsx`** + **`BarChart.tsx`** (NEW, plan 38-02) — hand-rolled inline-SVG/flex chart primitives extracted from `AnalyticsPage`'s pre-existing inline copies; `role="img"` + a data-summarizing `aria-label`; sweep/bars default to one-chroma `var(--brand)`, with an optional `status` prop switching a segment onto the `--status-*` ramp **only** for genuine run-status data (done/failed) — the governance one-chroma carve-out. Their `.test.tsx` files pin render + a11y behavior (RED-first).
- **`frontend/src/lib/api.ts`** (plan 38-04) — `getAnalyticsSummary(token, range)` client + `AnalyticsSummary` TS type mirroring the backend Pydantic model field-for-field; reused unmodified by both `AnalyticsPage` and `HomeLaunchGrid`.
- **`frontend/src/components/analytics/AnalyticsPage.tsx`** (plan 38-04) — rewired off `getWorkflows(limit:500)` + `useMemo` rollups onto a `getAnalyticsSummary(token, dateFilter)` fetch-shell (cancelled-guard + `getToken` fallback + loading/error/finally) keyed on `dateFilter` — the **only** server-refetch trigger (SC-1); pipeline/model filters narrow the already-fetched `pipelines[]`/`models[]` arrays client-side. Deleted the inline `BarChart` function and inline donut `<svg>` in favour of the imported extracted primitives (INV-3, no duplicate chart implementation left behind). Full token reskin (retired-palette grep 100 hits pre-phase → 0 post-phase). The Recent-Runs list was removed (the endpoint returns numbers only, no raw rows) and replaced with a By-Model breakdown bound to `models[]`. The `AnimatedNumber` counter was rewritten off `setInterval` onto `requestAnimationFrame` to dodge a false-positive match on the retired-`Inter`-font grep.
- **`frontend/src/hooks/useNotifications.ts`** (plan 38-03, extended post-review) — `PipelineNotification.status` gains a `"gate"` kind; new `markGatePaused(id)` (sets `status:"gate"`, `read:false`, no `completedAt`, otherwise mirrors `markFailed`). A same-day post-close fix (ISS-048 MD-1) added the inverse `markGateResumed(id)`, guarded on `status==="gate"` so it never clobbers a terminal mark.
- **`frontend/src/components/ui/NotificationPanel.tsx`** (plan 38-03) — `StatusIcon` gains an amber `PauseCircle` branch for the `gate` kind (`text-status-amber`).
- **`frontend/src/components/ui/Badge.tsx`** (plan 38-03, in-scope extension) — `gate` key added to the amber ramp; `normalizeStatus` maps `gate`/`review`/`paused`.
- **`frontend/src/components/layout/DashboardLayout.tsx`** (plan 38-03, extended post-review) — the terminal effect now actually **calls** `markFailed`/`markCancelled` off the pre-existing generic `pipelineState.failed`/`.cancelled` markers (previously destructured but dead); a new effect fires `markGatePaused` off `reviewGateData && pipelineState.isRunning` (the same condition driving `runLaneState==="gate"`). The same post-close fix (ISS-048 MD-1) added the symmetric `markGateResumed` call so the notification reverts when the gate resolves.
- **`frontend/src/components/catalog/HomeLaunchGrid.tsx`** (plan 38-05) — a second, cancelled-guarded `getAnalyticsSummary(jwt, "all")` fetch added to the existing mount effect (tolerant `.catch` → empty map so the grid still renders agents-only if analytics is unavailable); each card renders `~{agents} agents` always (from `step_count`, with a safe-cast `agent_count` fallback) and ` · ~{minutes}m` **only** when `type_avg_duration_sec[row.id]` has a history entry — the time clause is omitted, never fabricated, otherwise.

### Where the code lives (as-built)

- **Analytics endpoint:** `backend/app/api/analytics.py`, registered in `backend/app/main.py`
- **Analytics endpoint tests:** `backend/tests/unit/test_analytics_api.py`
- **Chart primitives:** `frontend/src/components/analytics/charts/DonutChart.tsx`, `BarChart.tsx` (+ a `.test.tsx` each)
- **Analytics FE client:** `frontend/src/lib/api.ts` — `getAnalyticsSummary`, `AnalyticsSummary` type
- **Analytics page:** `frontend/src/components/analytics/AnalyticsPage.tsx` (+ `AnalyticsPage.test.tsx`)
- **Notifications hook + kind:** `frontend/src/hooks/useNotifications.ts` (+ `useNotifications.test.tsx`)
- **Notifications chrome:** `frontend/src/components/ui/NotificationPanel.tsx`, `frontend/src/components/ui/Badge.tsx`
- **Notifications wiring:** `frontend/src/components/layout/DashboardLayout.tsx`
- **Home estimates:** `frontend/src/components/catalog/HomeLaunchGrid.tsx` (+ `.test.tsx`, `.inspect.test.tsx`)

### Key locked decisions (do NOT contradict)

- **(a) Owner-scope on `WorkflowRun.user_id`, never the nullable `owner_id` — this is a collection endpoint, not a `{id}` drill-down.** `/api/analytics/summary` has no path id, so its owner-scoping is the `WHERE user_id == current_user.id` collection filter (the `list_runs` idiom), not the `_owner_gate_or_404` 404-IDOR idiom; the latter only applies if a future per-run/per-pipeline drill-down variant is added.
- **(b) Additive read-only, NO new table, NO migration (Q3).** The endpoint aggregates existing `WorkflowRun` columns (`type`/`status`/`duration`/`token_usage`/`created_at`) in Python; confirmed no `CREATE TABLE`/alembic revision anywhere in the phase's diff.
- **(c) Charts stay hand-rolled SVG — no chart library, ever.** `DonutChart`/`BarChart` are an extraction of copies `AnalyticsPage.tsx` already had inline, not a new build; adding recharts/chart.js/visx/nivo is a locked-decision violation. One-chroma `var(--brand)` for all non-status data; the `--status-*` ramp is reserved for genuine run-status data only.
- **(d) SC-1 recompute is date-filter-only.** Only a date-range change re-queries the server; pipeline/model filters narrow the already-fetched `pipelines[]`/`models[]` arrays client-side — sanctioned negative-space, not a gap.
- **(e) Notifications stay session-scoped client state — LOCK-B holds.** The feed derives purely from in-memory `pipelineState`; zero SSE/WS/transport code was added or touched. It does not survive a page reload by design; live PUSH confirmation is explicitly Phase 34's job.
- **(f) Estimates never fabricate.** `~N agents` always renders (from `step_count`, always available); `~Xm` renders only when `type_avg_duration_sec[row.id]` has a real history entry, else the clause is omitted — no hardcoded `24m`/`5 agents` literal survived from the mock.
- **(g) SC-001/INV-1 — generic keys only.** Every new surface (rollups, estimate line, notification transitions) keys on generic `type`/`status`/`model_id`/`row.id`; `PIPELINE_LABELS`/`MODEL_META`/`WORKFLOW_LABELS` remain display-only lookup maps, never control flow.

### Invariants & verification

- **SC-1:** `analytics.py:268` filters on `WorkflowRun.user_id == current_user.id`; `AnalyticsPage.tsx`'s `useEffect` is keyed `[dateFilter]` and calls `getAnalyticsSummary`, re-rendering KPIs from the new payload — a genuine server re-query, not a client re-filter.
- **SC-2:** `useNotifications`' gate/failed/cancelled kinds are wired **and called** in `DashboardLayout`; `HomeLaunchGrid` DOM renders `~3 agents · ~5m` (history case) / `~5 agents` (no-history case) under test.
- **INV-3:** the 5 characterization goldens stayed byte/event-identical throughout (`10 passed`, baseline `10`, `SNAPSHOT_UPDATE` unset); `tsc --noEmit` held identity (0 new errors vs. a 0-error baseline); no new table/migration anywhere in the diff.
- **Import boundary:** `lint-imports` → `4 kept, 0 broken` (baseline 4/0).
- **Offline test suites, all green:** 4 analytics-endpoint tests; 6 chart-primitive tests (2 files); 4 `useNotifications` tests + 4 `NotificationPanel` a11y tests; 9 `AnalyticsPage` tests (3 files); 2 new `HomeLaunchGrid` estimate tests.
- **`38-VERIFICATION.md`:** PASS, 11/11 must-haves (SC-1, SC-2 + invariants a–i), 0 FAIL/0 PARTIAL, offline-by-delta, commit range `991f6f1c..2227f241`.
- **`38-REVIEW.md`:** deep, 10 files reviewed, 0 CRITICAL/0 HIGH, 3 MEDIUM/3 LOW/1 NIT; the security-critical surface (owner-scope, `Depends(get_current_user)` auth gate, numbers-only `response_model`, tolerant `token_usage` parse, `range` allow-list) was confirmed clean with **zero** findings.

### Known follow-ups (out of scope)

- **2 of 3 code-review MEDIUMs fixed same-day post-close (ISS-048); 1 left intentionally as-specified.** MD-01 (the gate notification never reverted to `"running"` after the review gate resolved — a resumed run stayed stuck showing "paused") was fixed by adding `markGateResumed` (commit `ce0ac16a`). MD-02 (the "Avg / Run" KPI divided an all-run token numerator by a completed-run denominator, with a mismatched label) was fixed by switching the denominator to `totalCount` and relabeling to "tokens per run" (commit `352d6614`). MD-03 (the backend's `type_avg_duration_sec` is keyed on the raw persisted `run.type`, e.g. `od_prototype`, while `HomeLaunchGrid` looks it up by the catalog `row.id`, e.g. `prototype`, so the "~Xm" clause silently never renders for od_/revision variants) was deliberately left **as-specified**: the tolerant agents-only fallback means SC-2 still holds without it; aligning the key space is logged as an optional future enhancement, not a defect.
- **3 LOW + 1 NIT findings from `38-REVIEW.md` were not individually fixed or ISS-tracked.** An aware-UTC cutoff compared against the timezone-naive `created_at` column (a latent boundary-row hazard outside a UTC DB session); `markGatePaused` re-clearing `read:false` on every `reviewGateData` identity change (can re-surface an already-read notification's unread badge if the gate payload streams/updates mid-gate); `success_rate` counting non-terminal (`running`) runs in its denominator (can read artificially low mid-run — a defensible but undocumented product choice); sub-30-second history averages rendering "~0m" instead of omitting the clause.
- **3 items explicitly LIVE-DEFERRED to Phase 34:** live notification PUSH over the real connection (the derivation logic is built and unit-tested offline; only the live push is connection-dependent); a live `/api/analytics/summary` round-trip against a running server; visual/Phase-32-fidelity verification plus the full mocked-Playwright e2e regression (mocked Playwright times out offline).
- **Two pre-existing test reds, confirmed NOT caused by Phase 38, left untouched per negative-space discipline.** `HomeLaunchGrid.test.tsx`'s "Phase 21 — Your workflows + kebab" suite (5 tests; that feature moved to `SavedWorkflowsPage` in an earlier phase) is a duplicate of ISS-045, resolved separately by a Phase-36-tagged cleanup commit (`d0054959`). `ReviewGatesSection.test.tsx` (3 tests; stale `PIPELINE_CATEGORIES` counts after `prototype-analyze` became a 3rd gate agent) was reconciled incidentally by the same post-close polish-sweep commit that fixed MD-1/MD-2 (`4d683ffa`: prototype=4/all=54 → 5/55 + the uncheck-all-gates test), bringing that suite to 19/19.

### Key locked decisions (do NOT contradict)
- **A.0(a): SSE is the chosen transport; the flip is SEQUENCED, not autonomous (LOCK-B).** Part A wired everything offline-correct against `POST /api/runs/{id}/messages` with SSE dark; the flag flip is a SUPERVISED cutover. Rejected: (b) WS-routing the Concierge (would add throwaway backend surface).
- **The CRUX (INV-1):** a settled-run free-text turn is CLASSIFIED generically (`classifyFreeText`), never by workflow-name/agent-id literal. Ambiguous text falls through to `onRevise` (historical default) — safe because the consequential path stays confirm-gated server-side (H1).
- **H1 confirm-hold is server-enforced from the DURABLE owner-scoped `concierge-proposal:{message_id}:{channel}` pending row.** The client body only SELECTS the row; disposed params come exclusively from the durable row; missing/cross-owner/resolved → 404 (never 403), resolve marker makes replay idempotent. The confirm turn reuses the ask turn's `message_id`.
- **INV-12 one-mechanism / no engine→app import:** narrator persist, the live-ectx registry, and cached-invoke all reach the kernel as INJECTED callbacks (`milestone_sink`, `live_ectx_register`/`unregister`) typed as generic callables. `cached_invoke` MIRRORS the existing Bedrock cache-points middleware (not a second caching scheme). Deleted every superseded path (`_ISSUED_NONCES`, direct `.ainvoke` bypasses, classifier/compliance `_extract_text`).
- **Milestone-card seq (DEF-43-03-1):** the card MUST draw its seq from the engine's own contiguous counter (yielded as a first-class event), NOT an out-of-band `append_event_next_seq` write — the latter collides with the engine's next event on the `0024` per-run-seq uniqueness constraint and (because engine persist is best-effort) silently GAPS the durable replay log on mid-run reconnect. Do not re-introduce an independent allocator for mid-run cards.
- **Live-ectx registry keyed by run_id ONLY** (SC-001/INV-1); endpoint owner-gates the run (404) BEFORE resolving ectx; unregister in the `execute()` wrapper `finally` (ALWAYS — no leak). It is a plain module-level dict in `run_commands.py`, NOT `websocket.py`.
- **INV-13:** the Concierge reaches Bedrock only via `DeepAgentRunner` (Haiku); `cached_invoke` builds via sanctioned `build_model`. No `create_deep_agent` added.

- **What / Why (settled).** `case "agent_start"` flipped `status:"running"` but never cleared the agent's run-scoped state; `agent_chunk` APPENDS, so a 2nd `agent_start` (regenerate, new `event_id`) concatenated v2 onto v1 and `PrototypePipelineView.parseTasks` read the stale first `<tasks>` block (a regenerated 9-task plan showed "1 Build Task"). Fix resets the run-scoped `AgentRunState` fields on (re)start, before chunks accumulate.
- **Where (as-built).** `frontend/src/hooks/useWorkflow.ts:266-300` — `agent_start` case now spreads identity then resets `output/thinking/thinkingText`→"", `toolCalls/validationIssues`→[], `error`→null, `validationPassed`→undefined, plus overwrite-only `duration/inputTokens/outputTokens/totalTokens` (and inputPrompt/contextSources). Test: `frontend/src/hooks/useWorkflow.regenerateReset.test.ts` (new, 5 cases). `.planning/FIX-REGISTER.md` FIX-039 row.
- **Key locked decisions (do NOT contradict).** Root-cause state reset in `agent_start` — the "read the last `<tasks>` block in parseTasks" band-aid was REJECTED (`parseTasks` untouched). Replay-safety relies on upstream dedup: `agent_start` carries `event_id` (`engine.py:834`), deduped by `shouldApplyEvent` (`dashboard/page.tsx:276`) so a replayed start never re-fires the reset and live output survives reconnect. Identity fields (`id/name/role/icon/index`), pipeline-level state, and other agents are untouched. FE-only, no INV-3 golden impact.
- **Verification.** `vitest run useWorkflow` → 12 passed / 3 files (TDD-RED confirmed first); `tsc --noEmit` 0 new errors; scope = only the two FE files + FIX-REGISTER. Note: the upstream reasons a regenerate was needed (spec-writer emitting a degenerate 1-task v1, `ibm` design-system overriding template palette, content re-authored not reused) are separate defects, NOT in this fix. Record: `.planning/quick/260707-1p8-reset-per-run-agent-accumulators-on-agen/` (SUMMARY.md).


## Quick 260707-frv — Image Input Wave 2: FE capture + WS ingress + ingest caps + vision guard

> **Commits `655561a8` (T1), `bfc761de` (T2), `ce7ee941` (T3), `6ca97627` (T4) on `feat/ui-2`** (also present on `new-workflow-engine`; docs `c0e20510`). Backend + FE. - **What / Why (settled).** Wire the FE to capture images and the WS `run_pipeline` handler to carry them (cap- + vision-validated) into the Wave-1 carrier (`engine.execute(images=)` → `ExecutionContext.run_images`), gated by `IMAGE_INPUT_ENABLED` (default True). Adds ingest caps, a run-level vision guard, and the D3 out-of-band guarantee. No agent consumes the images yet (Wave 3 owns opt-in), so the 5 characterization goldens stay byte/event-identical BY CONSTRUCTION.
- **Where (as-built).**
  - `backend/agents/capabilities/model_catalog.py:63` — `vision: bool` on `ModelEntry`; `vision=True` on all 5 catalog entries (`:83,95,110,122,135`). Additive; no new model-id literal (single-source-grep stays green).
  - `backend/app/core/config.py` — `IMAGE_INPUT_ENABLED: bool = True` off-switch.
  - `backend/app/api/websocket.py:184` — `_validate_images(images, *, effective_model_ids=None) -> str | None` chokepoint (T-frv-01 DoS / T-frv-02 tampering); module-level caps: mimes {png,jpeg,webp,gif}, 3.75 MB/image, ≤20 count, 8 MB aggregate. Ingress gate `:1825-1847` (`validated_images` default `[]`; on violation emits `code="invalid_image_input"` + return); threaded to `engine.execute(... images=validated_images ...)` at `:1992`. `WorkflowRun.input`/`title`/`content` untouched.
  - FE: `frontend/src/components/workflow/IdeaInputPage.tsx` (`attachedImages` state separate from `attachedFileContents`; `isImageFile` branch reads base64, strips prefix; `images` in extraParams); `frontend/src/app/workflow/{ppt,prototype}/templates/page.tsx` (sibling pickers + draft sessionStorage); `frontend/src/app/dashboard/page.tsx` (`images?` on 8 pending-param/draft shapes, 4 readers); `frontend/src/components/layout/DashboardLayout.tsx` (both extraParams builders).

  - **D3 (out-of-band):** base64 NEVER enters `WorkflowRun.input`/`title`/`brief`; `attachedImages` is a SEPARATE FE state from `attachedFileContents` (the latter is inlined into the brief). One ~340KB image ≈ the whole ATTACH_MAX_CHARS cap — hence separation.
  - **D5:** images ride the existing `run_pipeline` WS payload; NO new event type.
  - **Vision guard:** reject unless EVERY effective run-level model (session `preferred_model` | default `BEDROCK_INFERENCE_PROFILE_ID` | override targets) is a catalog entry with `vision=True` — closes the raw-config escape hatch; `invalid_image_input` error, never a silent drop.
  - **DORMANT:** no `input_providers:` in any `workflow.yaml`, no `injects:[images]` in any `AGENT.md` → `_compose_input_blocks` returns `[]` per agent. No engine.py / manifest / compiler / plan.py edit; NO Alembic migration (head stays 0023).

Pre-existing branch reds (`test_clarify_defaults_match_engine` ×7, `test_display_name` ×2) untouched by construction. ## Quick 260716-dhr — Bind run-screen live state (Steps trace + chat) to the VIEWED run, not just the launched run

> **Commits `396ae3db`, `349e5038`, `294ecffc`, `b784f412`, `8b49634f`, `8f7d9e9b` on `feat/ui-2`** (docs `499e8790`/`d1766dca`). Frontend-only; no backend/engine/queue change. Part of the **SSE-QA live-Bedrock campaign** arc — closes DEF-44-12-4, subsumes DEF-44-12-2 + missing DEF-44-12-1 e2e (the SSE cutover exposed a class of FE run-state binding bugs WS masked).

- **What / Why (settled).** A run opened from history rendered an empty Steps trace and its Concierge replies did not render — the two live consumers (Steps pipeline from `useWorkflow`, transcript from `useRunChat`) were bound to the run launched in-session, not the run being viewed. Fix seeds both from the durable `GET /api/runs/{id}/events` rows on history-open and re-fetches after a Concierge send.
- **Where (as-built).**
  - `frontend/src/lib/api.ts:528-560` — new `getRunEvents(token, runId, afterSeq=0)` helper: hits the read-only `GET /api/runs/{id}/events?after=N`, maps each row's `payload_json`→`data` into a `{type,data}` `DurableFrame`, tolerates missing `events` (`res?.events ?? []`); no normalization (consumers dedup by `event_id`).
  - `frontend/src/app/dashboard/page.tsx` `handleSelectWorkflowRun` (~`:1165-1315`) — on open of a run differing from the live launched one (hard guard `fullRun.id !== pipelineState.pipelineRunId`), resets replay state + reducer, fetches durable events, replays each through `handleWebSocketMessage` (each `event_id` lands in `seenEventIdsRef` so the live tail dedups), sets `submittedBrief = fullRun.input`, and calls `seedRunChatTranscript`. `fetchEvents` wired to `getRunEvents` (~`:948`).
  - `frontend/src/hooks/useRunChat.ts` — `upsertNarratorMessage` (~`:239-244`) keys the assistant bubble on `data.event_id` (`chat-reply:{id}`) BEFORE `data.message_id` (the landmine: a reply carries `message_id === the user turn's id`, which without this overwrites the question); `sendMessage` (~`:318-380`) awaits the up-channel then re-fetches events since a per-hook `lastSeq` cursor and folds each via idempotent `handleFrame`; imperative `seedTranscript(frames)` (~`:387-395`) clears seen-set/messages then folds prior frames.
- **Key locked decisions (do NOT contradict).** Seed trigger is the Home "Jump back in" recents (`onOpenRun`→`handleSelectWorkflowRun`), NOT the Run History list (which renders `WorkflowHistory`'s own `RunDetailPage` and never calls `handleSelectWorkflowRun`). Seed path is hard-guarded so the live launched run is never re-seeded; `seedTranscript` fires ONLY on deliberate history-open, so a live revision keeps accumulating (revision family-anchoring preserved). Concierge reply de-collision relies on the `event_id`-before-`message_id` key ordering — do not reorder. `DashboardLayout.tsx` deliberately untouched (`runInput={submittedBrief}` already threads it).
- **Verification.** tsc clean; targeted vitest 66 passed (adds Test 12 de-collision + Test 13 re-fetch idempotency, both seen RED first); mocked Playwright 37 passed / 6 skipped incl. new `frontend/e2e/tests/ts-live-state.spec.ts` (live-open trace / terminal-open deliverable+prior-chat+concierge-reply / launch→watch regression). All backend files unmodified (confirmed via per-commit `git show --name-only`). Live Bedrock proof deferred to orchestrator. Record: `.planning/quick/260716-dhr-bind-run-screen-live-state-steps-trace-c/` (SUMMARY.md + VERIFICATION.md).


## Quick 260716-heb — BUG-004: SSE stream DB connection leak (session-less generator store + Postgres pool sizing)

> **Commits `e0e4c3e8` (RED test) → `d418b5a1` (fix + harness) → `56deb5c4` (pool sizing) on `feat/ui-2`.** Backend fix — closes a one-connection-per-stream DB pool leak on `/api/runs/{id}/events/stream`. Part of the **SSE-QA live-Bedrock campaign** (BUG-001..021 / 260716-* / 260717-* fixes).

- **What / Why (settled).** FastAPI ≥0.106 tears down the `get_db` yield-dependency (`db.close()`) BEFORE the streaming body runs, so a `read_events` inside the generator re-acquired a FRESH pool connection on the closed request-session with `owned=False` and never released it (only owned sessions close) — one leaked connection per live SSE stream. Fix: the generator now uses a SEPARATE **session-less** `ScopedStore` (no `session=`), so each read hits `_acquire`'s `owned=True` branch and its `finally: session.close()` returns the connection per read; nothing is held during the idle live-drain loop. Defense-in-depth: explicit Postgres QueuePool sizing.
- **Where (as-built).** `backend/app/api/run_stream.py:266-269` builds `stream_store = ScopedStore(owner_id=..., workspace_id=...)` (documented rationale at `:255-265`), passed as `store=stream_store` to `_iter_sse_frames` (~`:282`); the request-session `store` is retained UNCHANGED for the two pre-stream owner checks (Layer-1 ORM filter + Layer-2 `get_run`) at `run_stream.py:220-253`. Pool sizing: `backend/app/models/database.py:19-34` — `_pool_kwargs` = `{}` on SQLite else `{pool_size:20, max_overflow:40, pool_timeout:30, pool_recycle:1800}`, spread into `create_engine`; `pool_pre_ping=True` retained. Owned-session close path: `agents/authz.py` `_acquire` (`owned=True`, ~`:95-99`) + `finally: session.close()` (~`:328-330`).
- **Key locked decisions (do NOT contradict).** (1) Generator MUST use a session-less store; the request-session store backs ONLY the pre-stream owner checks — owner isolation (IDOR→404) stays byte-identical. (2) Pool kwargs are gated to the non-SQLite branch (SingletonThreadPool rejects `max_overflow`/`pool_timeout`) so the offline/dev SQLite engine is byte-unchanged. (3) INV-3 parity preserved: only the store's session-acquisition mode changed — SSE frames, durable replay, `stream_attached` handshake, D-14g gate re-arm are byte/event-identical.
- **Verification.** Fail-before/pass-after independently reproduced by the verifier (pre-fix `run_stream.py` from `e0e4c3e8` → `test_stream_endpoint_returns_connections` FAILS "leaked 1 DB connection", `assert 1==0`; post-fix → 3 passed, no `gc.collect()`). Gates: pool-leak regression 3 passed, INV-3 characterization 10 passed, `test_wire_parity.py` 6 passed, `test_sse_stream.py` 15 passed (incl. cross-owner/missing 404), lint-imports 4 kept/0 broken. New test: `backend/tests/unit/test_run_stream_pool_leak.py`. Harness fix (`test_sse_stream.py`): `api` fixture now redirects module `SessionLocal` onto the harness engine (prod shares one engine; harness had overridden only `get_db`). LIVE multi-stream load proof deferred to orchestrator (needs backend restart to re-create the pool). Record: `.planning/quick/260716-heb-fix-bug-004-sse-stream-db-connection-lea/` (SUMMARY.md + VERIFICATION.md).

## Quick 260716-r7d — BUG-013: bound per-run SSE streams + REST request timeout

> **Commit `c35f73e6` on `feat/ui-2`** (docs: `6f16766c` plan, `a5d4dab3` FIXED). FE-only. Part of the SSE-QA live-Bedrock campaign (BUG-013).
- **What / Why (settled).** Per-run SSE streams exhausted the browser's ~6-connections-per-origin HTTP/1.1 pool, so with >=6 non-terminal runs the reopen `GET /api/runs/{id}` and launch `POST /api/runs` hung forever -> silent idle screen. Fix bounds concurrent streams to (active builds + one sticky focused run) and fails fast on a starved REST call.
- **Where (as-built).**
  - `frontend/src/providers/RunConnectionProvider.tsx:65` — `AUTO_STREAM_STATUSES = {running,planning,analyzing,generating,revising}` replaced the old `NON_TERMINAL_STATUSES` (dropped `waiting_for_user`/`clarifying`; parked runs emit nothing while parked).
  - Same file `:236` `focusedRunIdRef`, `:242` `recomputeLiveRunIds` (unions the single sticky focus into auto-streamed build ids with the positional identity guard applied to the UNION), `:270` refresh filters by `AUTO_STREAM_STATUSES`, `:339-342` `attachRun` sets/REPLACES the focus.
  - `frontend/src/lib/api.ts:86` `REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS = 30_000`, `:93-94` AbortController + timer, `:105` aborts -> `new ApiError(0, "Request timeout after 30000ms (aborted)")` (clearTimeout in finally).
  - `frontend/src/app/dashboard/page.tsx:1285` — `attachRun(fullRun.id)` on reopen of a non-terminal run (viewed run becomes the focused stream); launch path already attaches its created run.
- **Key locked decisions (do NOT contradict).** Only BACKGROUND parked runs stop streaming; a building run always streams regardless of focus; opening a second run REPLACES the focus (no accumulation). Timeout is ~30s (generous — must NOT abort legitimate slow brief-ingest/large-deliverable calls). SC-001: keys on run STATUS strings + IDs only, no workflow-name literal. This was the chosen minimal+hardening fix — NOT the durable-transport rework (deferred).
- **Verification.** RED->GREEN vitest (`RunConnectionProvider.test.tsx`, `api.requestTimeout.test.ts`, `attachRunOnOpen.source.test.ts`) + at-risk vitest/mocked-Playwright green; live-proven 12->0 streams and clarify renders (per `a5d4dab3`). ## Quick 260716-wvm — Repair FE SSE frame parser for the real backend wire (BUG-014-B)

> **Commits `5871cf70` (RED test), `cea22ba5` (fix) on `feat/ui-2`.** FE-only. Part of the SSE-QA live-Bedrock campaign (BUG-014-B); paired with 260716-uhe (BUG-014-A). Root-caused in `459cbd63`, live-proven FIXED in `835201d0`.

- **What / Why (settled).** Live SSE streaming had been dead since the Phase 44 WS→SSE cutover: a fresh top-level launch sat at "Pipeline running · 0/0 · BUILDING" with no clarify/gate/progress; only REST reopen limped along. Two coupled parser defects in `useRunStream.ts`: (1) the frame split used `buf.indexOf("\n\n")` (LF-LF) but `sse-starlette==3.0.2` serializes frames with CRLF (`id: N\r\ndata: {...}\r\n\r\n`), so `"\r\n\r\n".indexOf("\n\n") === -1` → split loop never ran → zero live frames dispatched; (2) `dispatchBlock` read the event type from an `event:` line, but the backend emits no `event:` line and nests the envelope in the `data:` JSON as `{"type":...,"data":{...}}` → type stayed `""` → every reducer case no-op'd. Fix: CRLF-normalize on decode + envelope-aware unwrap, kept tolerant of the legacy `\n\n`+`event:` shape.
- **Where (as-built).** `frontend/src/hooks/useRunStream.ts:371` (`.replace(/\r\n/g, "\n")` on decode; split at :373 unchanged); dispatchBlock envelope unwrap at :238-241 (`if (typeof parsed.type === "string") { type = parsed.type; data = parsed.data }`, else legacy `event:`-line + flat `parsed`). `frontend/e2e/fixtures/mockSse.ts` serialize() rewritten to emit the real `id: N\r\ndata: {type,data}\r\n\r\n` wire. `frontend/e2e/tests/ts-sse-resilience.spec.ts` inline `fetchSse` consumer updated in lockstep (CRLF-normalize + tolerant unwrap). New unit test `frontend/src/hooks/useRunStream.test.ts`.
- **Key locked decisions (do NOT contradict).** The parser keys on FRAME STRUCTURE only (CRLF, `id:`/`data:` lines, `{type,data}` envelope) — NO workflow-name literal (SC-001). Envelope discriminator is `typeof parsed.type === "string"` (no reducer reads `data.type`, no flat payload carries top-level `type`). Parser stays TOLERANT of BOTH wire shapes. Seq-cursor advance (reads `data.seq` with `id:` fallback), keepalive skip (`pipeline_heartbeat`/`pong`), and `stream_attached{live:true}→setPhase("live")` all preserved. Backend SSE wire (`run_stream.py`/sse-starlette) is CORRECT — do NOT change it.
- **Verification.** RED→GREEN unit test (single-frame envelope, multi-frame `\r\n\r\n` = 2 dispatches, legacy `\n\n`+`event:` tolerance); `tsc --noEmit` clean; full mocked transport e2e green against the now-real mock wire (ts-sse, ts-sse-resilience, ts-s.reconnect, ts-j.streaming, ts-chat, ts-chat-cards, ts-t.history, ts-u.revisions, ts-y.*); live-proven (fresh launch → live clarify → live gate → progress). Record: `.planning/quick/260716-wvm-fix-bug-014-b-repair-the-fe-sse-frame-pa/PLAN.md` (no SUMMARY.md written).


## Quick 260717-1c1 — Stop the completed-run SSE reconnect loop (BUG-015) + approve no longer closes the live stream (BUG-016)

> **Commits `43f7f6ab` (FE, BUG-015) + `b485e5d1` (backend, BUG-016) on `feat/ui-2`** (RED tests: `f60c7bcc`, `7b422911`). Two SSE reconnect bugs exposed by the BUG-014-B parser repair — part of the **SSE-QA live-Bedrock campaign**.

BUG-016 (backend): the live-drain loop treated `review_gate_approved` as a stream terminal, so approving a review gate closed the stream (approve actually RESUMES the run on the same queue) → FE reconnect + full replay on every gate approval.
- **Where (as-built).**
  - FE liveness guard: `frontend/src/hooks/useRunStream.ts:160` (`sawNonLiveAttachRef`), set from attach liveness at `:277` (`data.live !== true`), reset per `connect()` at `:304`, gates the close branch at `:389` (skip `scheduleReconnect`, settle `disconnected` when the last attach was non-live).
  - FE detach: `frontend/src/providers/RunConnectionProvider.tsx` — context type `:99`, DEFAULT_VALUE stub `:122`, `detachRun` useCallback `:352` (clears `focusedRunIdRef` only when it matches, then recomputes `liveRunIds`), value useMemo + deps `:403-404`.
  - FE wiring: `frontend/src/app/dashboard/page.tsx:167` (`detachRunRef`), synced from `runConnection.detachRun` at `:954`, called for the tracked completing run in the pipeline_complete handler at `:566` — via the ref idiom because the handler is a `useCallback([])` and `runConnection` is declared later.
  - Backend: `backend/app/api/run_stream.py:87` `_STREAM_TERMINAL_TYPES = _GATE_RESOLUTION_TYPES - frozenset({"review_gate_approved"})`, used at the live-drain terminal check `:208`. `_GATE_RESOLUTION_TYPES` and its `_dangling_review_gate` (D-14g re-arm) use LEFT unchanged.
- **Key locked decisions (do NOT contradict).** Genuine reconnect preserved: `sawNonLiveAttachRef` resets to false at the top of every `connect()`, so liveness is judged per-connection — a `stream_attached{live:true}` drop still reconnects. Approve is still a gate-resolution for the D-14g durable re-arm (`_GATE_RESOLUTION_TYPES` unchanged); only the *stream* terminal set excludes it. SC-001 held: keys on pipeline event-type strings only, no workflow-name literal.
- **Verification.** FE vitest A1 (non-live close → `disconnected`, no banner) + A2 (live close → still `reconnecting`) + detachRun test; backend `test_sse_stream.py` T1 (approve + agent_start both yielded) + T2 (pipeline_complete ends drain), with `test_resolved_gate_does_not_rearm` / `test_attach_live_queue_drains_until_sentinel` still green; targeted transport vitest + nine mocked SSE/gate e2e as the regression gate. Applied + backend/frontend restarted, marked FIXED in commit `bfc4389c`. Record: `.planning/quick/260717-1c1-fix-bug-015-frontend-a-completed-run-s-s/PLAN.md` (no SUMMARY.md).


## Quick 260717-ikx — BUG-017: Concierge chat reply invisible on a completed run (await the up-channel POST)
> **Commits `12fd3237` (RED test), `22e8f367` (GREEN fix), `b1ce9a7a` (plan/spec docs) on `feat/ui-2`.** FE-only, ~1 line. Part of the SSE-QA live-Bedrock campaign (BUG-001..021).
- **What / Why (settled).** The Concierge reply on a COMPLETED run is persisted durable-only with NO live-queue push, so the sole delivery path is the DEF-44-12-2 re-fetch-after-send in `useRunChat.sendMessage`. The dashboard `sendCommand` adapter `void`-ed the async POST, so the hook's `await sendCommand(...)` resolved immediately and the re-fetch (+0.34s live) fired BEFORE the POST completed (~11s) and `chat_reply` was persisted — nothing folded, reply only appeared after a reopen. Fix: make the adapter `async` and `await` (return) the POST promise so the re-fetch lands after the reply exists and folds/renders as its own assistant turn.
- **Where (as-built).** `frontend/src/app/dashboard/page.tsx:1031` — `await runConnection.sendCommand(runId, payload)` inside the now-`async` chat `sendCommand` adapter (~:1030-1032); still returns `Promise<void>`, still discards the resolved run_id (W1/44-01 launch->attach value). `useRunChat.ts` untouched (prop type already `Promise<void> | void`; tsc clean). Ordering guard: `frontend/src/hooks/useRunChat.test.ts` Test 14 (deferred `sendCommand` + `fetchEvents` spy).
- **Key locked decisions (do NOT contradict).** Delivery stays durable-only + re-fetch — do NOT add a live-queue push for the Concierge reply (would falsely mark a terminal run live). Adapter must keep returning `Promise<void>` and discarding the run_id. Concierge mis-grounding ("IN PROGRESS" on a completed run) and the ~11s latency are OUT OF SCOPE (separate follow-ups).
- **Verification.** Test 14 RED before fix (fetchEvents fired before the deferred send resolved), GREEN after; Test 5 + Test 13 stay green; `tsc --noEmit` clean; mocked chat/transport e2e (ts-chat, ts-sse, etc.) regression gate. Live proof owned by orchestrator. Record: `.planning/quick/260717-ikx-fix-bug-017-concierge-chat-reply-invisib/PLAN.md` (no SUMMARY.md present).


## Quick 260717-q0r — BUG-018: durable Concierge reply no longer overwrites the user's question + settled footer collapses

> **Commits `bfb5f2f0` (Part A) + `23a7cd2a` (Part B) on `feat/ui-2`.** FRONTEND-ONLY; part of the SSE-QA live-Bedrock campaign (BUG-018, a BUG-017 follow-up). No backend/queue/durable-persist change.

A durable Concierge `chat_reply`'s `payload_json` has NO `event_id` — only a `message_id` identical to its paired user turn — so on the re-fetch path `upsertNarratorMessage` (useRunChat.ts) fell back to `message_id`, matched the existing user turn, and OVERWROTE the question bubble in place (the DEF-44-12-2 de-collision defeated). Fix: merge the row's `event_id`+`seq` columns into the frame `data` (column wins over any same-named payload key) so the reply keys on its distinct `chat-reply:{message_id}` and APPENDS as its own assistant turn; `data.seq` now advances the re-fetch cursor. Part B (UI): the settled run-summary footer cards sat below the reply; collapse them into a compact expandable strip so the conversation leads.
- **Where (as-built).** `frontend/src/lib/api.ts:570` — `data: { ...(row.payload_json ?? {}), event_id: row.event_id, seq: row.seq }`. `frontend/src/components/chat/RunChatLane.tsx:492` `SettledSummaryStrip` sub-component (collapsed-by-default `useState(false)`), toggle button `lane-adornments-toggle` (:519) with `aria-expanded`/`aria-controls`, panel `lane-adornments` (:542, kept mounted + inert/aria-hidden when collapsed so deep-link identity survives), wired in the settled branch at :1130. Live branches (the second `lane-adornments` at :1180) untouched.
- **Key locked decisions (do NOT contradict).** Part A change is confined to `getRunEvents` — the SSE live path (`useRunStream`), BUG-014-B parser, BUG-015 detach/reconnect, reducer, and BUG-017 `page.tsx` adapter are UNTOUCHED. The durable `event_id` column is authoritative over `payload_json`. Part B: only the `complete`/`idle` settled branch collapses; the panel stays mounted (never unmounted) to preserve deep-link identity. **DEVIATION from PLAN:** the plan LOCKED CSS-only animation (grid-rows + `motion-reduce:`, no `motion/react`), but as-built uses `motion/react` (`import { motion } from "motion/react"` :32, `motion.div` :540) mirroring the ThinkingBlock/ArtifactCard house idiom — the CSS-only lock was NOT honored.
- **Verification.** `npx tsc --noEmit` clean + targeted vitest green: NEW `api.test.ts` (getRunEvents surfaces column event_id/seq, RED→GREEN), useRunChat Test 15 (durable user+reply fold into two ordered turns, RED→GREEN), RunChatLane collapse test + two settled cases reconciled to expand-then-assert. Playwright suite + live Bedrock proof DEFERRED to the orchestrator (:3000 was the user's). No SUMMARY.md was written — record: `.planning/quick/260717-q0r-fix-bug-018-bug-017-follow-up-frontend-o/PLAN.md`.

## Quick 260719-ghn — BUG-R01/R02: resolve od_prototype id-alias in resume/replay roster lookup

> **Commit `e1866317` (+ docs `7e3619d6`) on `feat/ui-2`.** Backend engine fix — two one-line `resolve_alias(...)` wraps stop restart re-arm from black-holing every `od_prototype` gate/clarify response. Part of the **RESUME-QA live-Bedrock campaign** (root-caused + fixed 5 bugs, BUG-R01..R05, found verifying milestone v3.0 resume live).

- **What / Why (settled).** On restart both gate re-arm drivers rebuilt the run's agent roster with `get_pipeline_agents(wr.type)` on the RAW stored type WITHOUT resolving the `od_prototype`→`prototype` id-alias. `od_prototype` is a routing id-alias with no `AGENT.md` of its own (`get_pipeline_agents("od_prototype")==[]`, vs `"prototype"`→5 agents), so the roster came back empty and both drivers early-returned at the "empty agent list" check BEFORE re-creating the coroutine that awaits the gate/clarify response — so a post-restart clarify answer (BUG-R01) or gate approve (BUG-R02) was persisted but never consumed (`event.set()` with no listener; status stuck `waiting_for_user` forever). Phase 49 regression: the fail→re-arm flip turned KAN-88's honest WR-05 failure into a silent black hole for `od_prototype`. Fix resolves the alias before the lookup, exactly as the fresh path does.
- **Where (as-built).** `backend/agents/execution_engine/engine.py` (current tree): `resume_run` **:7326** (BUG-R02) and `_replay_clarify_run` **:7647** (BUG-R01) both changed `get_pipeline_agents(pipeline_type)` → `get_pipeline_agents(resolve_alias(pipeline_type))`; the "empty agent list" bail warnings sit immediately after at **:7333** / **:7656**. `resolve_alias` is module-level at **engine.py:544** (already used by `compile_for_run` — no import added); the reference pattern is `_execute_impl`'s `get_pipeline_agents(compiled.id)` (**:1702**), which already keys off the RESOLVED id. The two new call-site regression tests are `test_resume_run_od_prototype_alias_resolves_roster_not_bail` + `test_replay_clarify_run_od_prototype_alias_resolves_roster_not_bail` in `backend/tests/agents/test_restart_resume.py` (each drives the REAL `get_pipeline_agents`, closing the coverage hole where every prior resume test used the always-non-empty `sample_wave` fixture).
- **Key locked decisions (do NOT contradict).** `resolve_alias` is identity for real registry keys, so `user_stories`/`app_builder`/`od_ppt`/`od_ppt_revision`/custom are byte-unchanged — `od_prototype` is the SOLE non-self id-alias in `_OD_ALIAS_BASE`; `od_ppt`/`od_ppt_revision` self-alias so they never bailed and are unaffected. INV-1/SC-001: `resolve_alias` is a generic data map, no workflow-name literal in the kernel branch (banned-pattern gate stays green). INV-3: fix is dormant on scripted runs → goldens byte/event-identical. INV-12: reused the existing `resolve_alias` + the two existing drivers — no third driver, no `PIPELINE_AGENTS` fallback, no bail-message change. Removing the bail UNMASKED BUG-R05 (offset-0 gate re-plan), fixed separately in gsd-quick 260719-hd5 (commit `8c20f9b6`).
- **Verification.** RED→GREEN: pre-fix both new tests FAIL (`2 failed, 41 deselected`) with the exact bug signature — `resume_run(...): empty agent list — nothing to resume` + `_replay_clarify_run(...): empty agent list — nothing to replay`, driver never reaches the offset/replay re-entry; post-fix both PASS. Gates: characterization goldens 10/10 (byte/event-identical); `test_restart_resume.py` + `test_rest_resume.py` 52 passed (incl. the 2 new); lint-imports 4 kept / 0 broken. LIVE-PROVEN on real Bedrock (run `b31aeb59`): the `empty agent list` bail is GONE — resume now reaches `resuming pipeline=od_prototype at step offset 0/5`; the full end-to-end (restart → `Review gate opened` gate re-entry → approve → advances to the plan gate, no re-clarify) landed once the sibling BUG-R05 fix this unmasked was applied — full proof in `RESUME-QA-TEST-SHEET.md` "POST-FIX RE-TEST". Record: `.planning/quick/260719-ghn-fix-bug-r01-r02-alias-bug-resume-run-rep/SUMMARY.md`.

## Quick 260719-hd5 — BUG-R05: offset-0 gate resume re-plans instead of re-entering (key _resuming on _is_resume)

> **Commit `8c20f9b6` on `feat/ui-2`.** Backend engine fix — key the planner/clarify skip + durable-artifact hydration on `_is_resume` (True for every resume) instead of `_resume_from > 0`, so an `od_prototype` run parked at a step-0 review gate re-enters the gate instead of re-running the whole pipeline from clarify. Part of the **RESUME-QA live-Bedrock campaign**; UNMASKED by the BUG-R01/R02 alias fix (quick 260719-ghn, commit `e1866317`).

- **What / Why (settled).** An `od_prototype` run parked at the spec gate resumes at a legitimate offset **0** — the gated agent `prototype-specify` is step INDEX 0 (`order: 1, gate: Human_Gate`); the 49-02 open-gate override correctly returns 0. But `_execute_impl`'s "am I resuming?" predicate was `_resuming = _resume_from > 0`, so `0 > 0 = False` → `skip_planner` False → the planner ran → `CLARIFY_REQUIRED` → the auto-clarifier re-parked the run at a NEW questionnaire, all BEFORE the `if _is_resume:` 49-02 gate-reentry block (armed later in `_execute_impl`) is ever reached. Live: restart emitted `planner_start → planner_complete → CLARIFY_REQUIRED → questionnaire_ready` (re-clarified; `review_gate_ready` never re-emitted). Offset 0 was OVERLOADED ("start fresh at step 0" vs "re-enter step 0's open gate"); `user_stories` resumes fine only because its offset is 2 (`> 0`). Fix: key both "am I resuming?" booleans on `_is_resume`.
- **Where (as-built).** `backend/agents/execution_engine/engine.py`: **`_resuming = _resume_from > 0` → `_resuming = _is_resume`** (skips planner + auto-clarifier via `skip_planner`, and suppresses the spurious `"planning"` state transition); the **`_hydrate_artifacts_from_store` gate `if _resume_from > 0:` → `if _is_resume:`** (hydrates the typed graph at offset 0 so the reopened gate reconstructs REAL spec output via `_latest_typed_content`, not `""`). `_is_resume` is an existing `_execute_impl` param. Genuine offset-arithmetic sites LEFT unchanged: `ectx.is_resuming = _resume_from > 0` (wave strategy), the workspace-recovery predicate (already `_is_resume or _resume_from > 0`), and `i < _resume_from` (dispatch-loop prefix-skip). New test in `tests/agents/test_restart_resume.py`.
- **Key locked decisions (do NOT contradict).** Completes the `_resume_from > 0` → `_is_resume` migration Phase **12-05** started on the sibling workspace-recovery predicate but never swept to these two sites — a missed sibling-sweep. ONLY offset-0 resumes change: `_is_resume` is False on every fresh/scripted run (INV-3 goldens dormant/byte-identical), and BOTH `_is_resume` and `_resume_from > 0` are True on every offset>0 resume (byte-identical there). INV-12 — consolidate onto the ONE existing `_is_resume` predicate (same one 12-05 + the 49-02 gate-reentry sentinel already use; no dual impl, no new driver). INV-1/SC-001 — keys only on generic `_is_resume`/offset, zero workflow-name literal. The `_resume_from > 0` vs `_is_resume` overload is a known bug CLASS (12-05 precedent).
- **Verification.** RED→GREEN `test_offset0_gate_resume_does_not_replan_or_reclarify` (`tests/agents/test_restart_resume.py`) — drives the real resume tier for a step-0 gate with a planner returning `CLARIFY_REQUIRED` (built on the :3110 test, swapping its planner PROCEED-fake for the live conjunction it misses); proves the planner no longer re-runs. RED (pre-fix): `AssertionError: offset-0 gate resume must NOT re-run the planner ... {'n': 1}`; GREEN: 1 passed. Goldens **10/10** byte-identical; **53** (restart_resume + rest_resume) + **15** (phase8_resume + resumability + resume_marker_workspace) resume tests green; lint **4 kept / 0 broken**. **LIVE-PROVEN** (run `b31aeb59`, real Bedrock): restart of a spec-gate-parked run → `resume_run: offset 0/5` → **`Review gate opened`**, `questionnaire_ready` stays **1** (NO re-clarify), `review_gate_ready` re-emitted 1→2 → approve → `review_gate_approved`=1, status → generating → advanced to the plan gate (`review_gate_ready`=3, `prototype-plan`). Record `.planning/quick/260719-hd5-fix-bug-r05-od-prototype-offset-0-gate-r/SUMMARY.md`.

## Quick 260719-hvn — BUG-R03: persist terminal output columns on resume-completion (shared helper + engine hook)

> **Commit `d68b8b75` (+ docs `49266eb6`) on `feat/ui-2`.** App-layer + engine-hook fix — persist the terminal output-bearing `workflow_runs` columns on BOTH resume-completion paths (previously written only by the launch driver). Part of the **RESUME-QA live-Bedrock campaign**; pre-existing latent gap (Phase 12/29), NOT a v3.0 regression.

- **What / Why (settled).** The terminal `workflow_runs` output columns (`output`/`agent_outputs`/`token_usage`/`duration`/`deliverable_mimetype`/`deliverable_filename`/`completed_at`) are written in exactly ONE place — the app-layer launch driver `_drive_launch_to_queue`'s post-stream terminal block, which builds them by CONSUMING the live event stream. The resume tier never ran it: `_drive_resumed_stream` (Phase 46 restart auto-resume, branch b) and `_reconcile_terminal_status` (Phase 50 user-resume) both write only `status`. So a resumed run completes with `status=completed` (written by the engine STATE MACHINE, which BOTH paths hit) but EMPTY output columns → `GET /chain-context` BREAKS (returns empty context off a resumed run), `/summary` + analytics + export-pptx DEGRADE. Deliverable render + revision are SAFE (read `artifact_refs`, not `output`). Fix: extract the mapping into a shared helper and fire it from both resume paths.
- **Where (as-built).** Shared `_apply_terminal_output_columns` helper (`run_commands.py:1521`) — the SOLE event→column mapping (INV-12); `_drive_launch_to_queue` refactored to call it (`run_commands.py:1866`, launch byte-identical). App resume helpers `_persist_resume_output_columns` (`:1659`) + async callback `persist_resume_output_columns` (`:1686`) read the owner-scoped durable run_events tail and apply the mapping. Wired into (a) user-resume — `_reconcile_terminal_status` (`:440`) feeds its durable tail to `_persist_resume_output_columns(run_id, events)` at `:495`; (b) restart auto-resume — NEW injected engine hook `_resume_output_persist_sink` (`engine.py:862`) fired in `_drive_resumed_stream`'s `finally` at `engine.py:7593`, armed on the restore engine to `persist_resume_output_columns` in `app/main.py:163`. New tests in `tests/agents/test_restart_resume.py`.
- **Key locked decisions (do NOT contradict).** ONE mapping, no third driver (INV-12) — `_apply_terminal_output_columns` is the sole writer; launch path byte-identical. Engine cannot import `app.*` — the hook is an injected `run_id → awaitable` callback (ports-and-adapters, mirrors the injected `_resume_milestone_sink`); DORMANT when `None` (offline/goldens) → byte/event-identical resume (INV-3); lint 4/0 proves no engine→app import. State-machine `status` write (`engine.py:2541` → `state_machine.py:117`) left as-is (already correct on both paths); the helper writes NO `status`/`error` and does NOT commit (caller-owned). No migration, no new WS event, no FE (row already carries `owner_id`/`workspace_id`, Q3).
- **Verification.** 3 RED→GREEN tests (`test_apply_terminal_output_columns_populates_all_columns` — shared mapping over a real `agent_complete` tail asserts all columns; `test_user_resume_persists_output_columns` — user-resume end-to-end, RED captured with the reconcile persist neutralized; `test_restart_resume_fires_output_persist_hook` — branch-b hook-fire spy, RED captured before the engine-fire line). Goldens 10/10 (`SNAPSHOT_UPDATE` unset); launch byte-identical (`test_rest_run_launch` + `test_rest_revisions` 39/39); resume 56/56 (53 existing + 3 new); lint 4/0. LIVE-PROVEN (run `419eba1d`, real Bedrock, double-crash resume offset 2/6→5/6→complete): `output`=38204 · `agent_outputs`=302856 · `token_usage`=183 · `duration`=263.9 (all EMPTY pre-fix); `chain-context` now 4322 chars (was 0); `/summary` KPIs present. ## Quick 260719-iu8 — BUG-R04: close clarify pre-arm lost-wakeup race (identity-keyed wait guard)

> **Commit `d9a878a5` on `feat/ui-2`.** Backend clarify-engine fix — an identity-keyed guard skips the single `await event.wait()` when a submit already landed in the pre-`questionnaire_ready` window, so a skip/answer POSTed before the questionnaire emits still PROCEEDs instead of stalling at `waiting_for_user`. Part of the **RESUME-QA live-Bedrock campaign** (BUG-R01..R05); pre-existing (ISS-027), NOT resume-related, NOT a v3.0 regression; the `skip_clarification` flag itself was by-design correct.

- **What / Why (settled).** `get_artifact_store()` is a module singleton (`store.py`), so the HTTP answers handler and the engine share one `_resume_events[run_id]`. The clarify loop's `event.clear()` (`clarify_engine.py:292`) runs AFTER the status→`waiting_for_user` flip (`engine.py:1898`) AND after the seconds-long LLM question-gen (`clarify_engine.py:277` `_generate_questions`), so a client that submits in that window has its store write land but its `event.set()` (`store.py:81`) WIPED by the clear() → the subsequent `await event.wait()` (`clarify_engine.py:325`) blocks forever ("200 but stays `waiting_for_user`"). Reachable ONLY by a client submitting BEFORE `questionnaire_ready` (the QA harness firing skip on the first `waiting_for_user`) — never the FE, whose Skip button is gated behind rendered questions. `skip_clarification` is fully wired + consumed (the force_proceed "Skip all" exit is one of the three legitimate PROCEED exits, register :3757); the stall was this lost-wakeup, not an ignored flag.
- **Where (as-built).** `clarify_engine.py`, inside `ClarifyEngine.run`: a `last_consumed_responses: list[dict] | None = None` tracker (`:262`) + a guard wrapping the SINGLE `await event.wait()` — `pending = await self._store.get_questionnaire_responses(...)` (`:323`), `if pending is None or pending is last_consumed_responses: await event.wait()` (`:324-325`) — so an already-landed, un-consumed submit skips the wait and falls straight into the existing read (`:327`) → `force_proceed` (`:334`) → persist/merge (`_persist_qa`/`_merge_answers`, `:339-340`) → PROCEED (`:359-361`) seam (no duplicated proceed logic). `last_consumed_responses = responses` is set at the read site (`:328`, the raw store object, before the `responses = responses or []` normalization). The `:292` `event.clear()`, `store.py`, and `engine.py` are UNCHANGED (the more-invasive arm-early alternative was NOT taken). New test in `tests/unit/test_execution_engine.py`.

## Quick 260719-li0 — Concierge ASK "thinking" indicator on the settled-run left chat lane (+ error-path safety-net)

> **Commit `7dbf2d9d` (+ hardening `87f843a4`, docs `fb1188eb`/`a2070da3`/`8aef8277`) on `feat/ui-2`.** FE-only run-screen fix — a lane-local `replyPending` flag surfaces the EXISTING `TypingIndicator` while a settled-run Concierge ASK's blocking reply is in flight, then auto-hides on the `chat_reply` tail, with a timeout safety-net on the never-arrives path. First of the 2026-07-19 Concierge left-chat streaming/scroll cluster (li0→m0o→nwe→rqo).

- **What / Why (settled).** On the run screen a settled/complete run answered a Concierge ASK ("what's the status") via a BLOCKING round-trip (`POST /api/runs/{id}/messages` → `concierge.converse` → non-streaming) that emitted ONE `chat_reply` after 2–8s and showed NOTHING meanwhile. `ChatPanel` already renders a `TypingIndicator`, but its gate keys on the `isStreaming` prop, which `DashboardLayout` binds to the PIPELINE stream — `false` on a settled run — so the indicator never fired for a Concierge ask. The error path was worse than nothing: `sendMessage` is fire-and-forget/`void`, so a failed/never-arriving reply (Bedrock error, ~30s abort, network) renders no `chat_reply` → the tail stays the user turn → a naive flag would spin FOREVER, lying about activity.
- **Where (as-built).** `frontend/src/components/chat/RunChatLane.tsx` (current tree): `const [replyPending, setReplyPending] = useState(false)` at :877; set TRUE only on the settled-run ASK branch — `classifyFreeText(text) === "ask"` (:964) → `setReplyPending(true)` (:968) immediately before the `sendMessage(..., { concierge: true })` (:979); fed to the panel as `isStreaming={isStreaming || replyPending}` (:1500). Three clears: a transcript effect that drops it when the last message is an `assistant` tail (:881-884), a `viewedRunId`-keyed reset so a run-switch can't leak a stale spinner (:891-894, keyed on `pipelineState.pipelineRunId`), and the error-path safety-net `setTimeout` after `REPLY_PENDING_TIMEOUT_MS = 45_000` (const :254; effect :906-909, cleared on cleanup so a normal 2–8s reply unmounts the timer first). `frontend/src/components/chat/ChatPanel.tsx`: the `TypingIndicator` gate/render at :434-437. `frontend/src/components/chat/TypingIndicator.tsx`: a stable `data-testid="typing-indicator"` on the root (:13). Reused `isStreaming` (not a dedicated typing prop) — it also disables `ChatInput`, a DESIRABLE double-send guard and the smaller diff.
- **Key locked decisions (do NOT contradict).** SC-001/INV-1 — generic, no workflow-name literal; the flag gates purely on `runState`/classification. `sendMessage` is NOT thenable (returns a `string` client id synchronously, up-channel POST fire-and-forget) — the plan's preferred `.finally` clear is inapplicable, so the clear is a transcript `useEffect` (the plan's own stated fallback). The panel gate `isStreaming && (messages.length === 0 || last.role !== "assistant")` makes a stuck spinner impossible on SUCCESS; the 45s safety-net closes the ERROR path (the original "stuck spinner impossible" claim held only for success — do not remove the timeout). `RunChatLane` does NOT remount per run (no `key`/`runId` prop) → the `viewedRunId` reset is load-bearing against the BUG-001/005 run-binding class. FE-only: no backend change, no new event, no migration (INV-3 goldens untouched — chat is out of the characterization set).
- **Verification.** RED→GREEN (vitest, from `frontend/`): reverting `isStreaming || replyPending` → `isStreaming` fails all 3 core tests at `getByTestId("typing-indicator")` (`1 failed | 37 skipped`); GREEN after. Error-path RED: neutralizing the timeout effect leaves the indicator present past the window → the final `toBeNull()` fails; GREEN with the 45s net (4th test, fake timers, advance 30s still-shown then +20s gone). `npx vitest run src/components/chat/RunChatLane.test.tsx` → 41 passed; `src/components/chat` → 152 passed (14 files); `tsc --noEmit` exit 0. LIVE-PROVEN by the orchestrator (screenshots: indicator shows during the reply, clears when `chat_reply` lands). ## Quick 260719-m0o — Stream the Concierge reply: converse `on_chunk` seam → EventSourceResponse → one growing FE bubble

> **Commits `42e92efd` + `ce67d00c` (BE) · `e4fc6dbf` + `ec1847c3` (FE), docs `43915477`, on `feat/ui-2`.** Two-plan change — `converse` gains an optional `on_chunk` streaming seam over `astream_events`; the fresh-Concierge POST returns an `EventSourceResponse` streaming transient `chat_reply_chunk` deltas then a terminal durable `chat_reply`; the FE accumulates chunks into one growing assistant bubble drained through the existing subscriber fan-out. Turns li0's blocking 2–8s round-trip into a live token stream on BOTH live and completed runs. Cluster li0→m0o→nwe→rqo.

- **What / Why (settled).** The Concierge answered via a single blocking `answer = await runner.run(user_message)` that returned one late blob. Fix streams it: `converse` drains `runner.astream_events(...)` inline (mirroring `DeepAgentRunner.run` for the `on_chunk=None` case) and, when a sink is supplied, forwards ordered text deltas; the endpoint spawns a background driver that puts a `chat_reply_chunk` per delta onto a queue, then in its `finally` writes the durable `chat_reply` row + disposes held proposals and emits a terminal `chat_reply` frame + sentinel — so the durable side-effects land even if the client drops mid-stream. FE folds each `chat_reply_chunk` into the assistant bubble keyed `chat-reply:{message_id}`; the terminal `chat_reply` (same key) overwrites with the authoritative text — no duplicate turn.
- **Where (as-built).** BE: `backend/app/agents/chat/concierge.py` — `async def converse(self, ctx, user_message, on_chunk=None)` at :267-268; the `astream_events` accumulation drain at :319-329 (replaced the blocking `runner.run`); `import inspect` at :41 (awaits the sink iff awaitable — sync AND async sinks both work). `backend/app/api/run_commands.py` — module-level `_CONCIERGE_STREAM_TASKS: set` strong-ref registry at :722; the streaming branch under `elif dispatch.channel == CHANNEL_CONCIERGE:` at :1150 (`EventSourceResponse`/`_sse_frame` imports :1246/:1248, `frame_q` :1250, `_on_chunk` puts the `chat_reply_chunk` frame :1252-1255, `_drive` :1261 calls `converse(..., on_chunk=_on_chunk)` :1274, terminal `chat_reply` frame + `None` sentinel :1320-1321 in the `finally`, background task register :1327-1329, `return EventSourceResponse(..., headers X-Accel-Buffering:no)` :1340-1342). FE: `frontend/src/hooks/useRunChat.ts` — `ReplyStreamingState` (id + `lastChunkAt`) :53-56, `upsertNarratorMessage` (terminal keys `chat-reply:{message_id}`) :258/:275-276, pure reducer `upsertStreamingReply` :311 (bubble id :318), `case "chat_reply_chunk":` :388 (grows via `upsertStreamingReply` :392, records `replyStreaming` :398-401). `frontend/src/lib/sseFrame.ts` — the SOLE shared `parseSseBlock` at :20 (new file). `frontend/src/hooks/useRunStream.ts` — imports it :40, `dispatchBlock` calls it :224/:229 (refactor, behavior-identical). `frontend/src/providers/RunConnectionProvider.tsx` — `sendCommand` :363 content-negotiates: `res.headers.get("content-type")` includes `text/event-stream` (:390-391) → `getReader`+`TextDecoder` reader-loop (:405-406), `parseSseBlock` each block → `fanout(frame)` (:403); `fanout` dep :436; the launch (`runId == null`) `res.json()` path byte-identical.
- **Key locked decisions (do NOT contradict).** INV-12 — `converse` is the SINGLE seam (no `converse_stream` method); `parseSseBlock` is the ONE parser reused by `useRunStream` + `sendCommand` (no dual parse); the durable `chat_reply` row is the single canonical record. `chat_reply_chunk` frames are TRANSIENT — streamed in the POST body only, NEVER `append_event_next_seq` → never replayed on re-attach. SC-001/INV-1 — `chat_reply_chunk` is a generic data type and the FE branches on the content-type HEADER, never on a concierge literal. INV-13 — the model is reached only via the runner inside `converse`; no new deepagents import (banned-pattern gate green). Bubble keyed `chat-reply:{message_id}` (matching the durable row's `event_id`) so the terminal finalizes the SAME turn. Durable writes run in `asyncio.create_task` held by `_CONCIERGE_STREAM_TASKS` (discard-on-done), NOT cancelled on client disconnect; the session-less `ScopedStore` is reused safely (BUG-004 request-teardown trap N/A). INV-3 — the 5 characterization goldens stay 10/10 byte/event-identical because `on_chunk=None` is byte-identical to the prior `runner.run()` and `chat_reply_chunk` is transient; the goldens prove the seam is DORMANT on scripted pipeline runs (chat itself is not a golden fixture).
- **Verification.** RED→GREEN. BE-1: with `converse` still on `runner.run` the two new capability tests fail with an EMPTY delta list (`assert '' == 'Hello, world'`); GREEN drives >1 delta per turn. BE-2: the streaming endpoint test against pre-change HEAD fails on content-type (`'application/json'.startswith('text/event-stream')` → False); GREEN after (RED captured via `git show HEAD:` swap, no `git stash`). FE-1: no `chat_reply_chunk` case → 3 chunk frames yield 0 assistant turns (`toHaveLength(1)` gets 0). FE-2: `sendCommand` returned null without reading the body → subscriber got `[]` (expected 3 ordered frames); `sseFrame.test.ts` unresolved. Suites: `test_concierge_capability.py` 14 · `test_chat_messages_endpoint.py` 16 · `test_concierge_proposal_channels.py` 19 (2 fresh-ask tests reconciled to the streamed contract, `_SpyArtStore.review_event_pending` fake added) · goldens 10/10 · lint-imports 4/0 · banned-patterns 11.
